title: Intergalactic ID
provenance: Created as a protection talisman for ethical businesses navigating bureaucratic corruption...
imageAlt: Council ID sticker - holographic credential card with cryptic interdimensional authority details
description:
The Intergalactic Council ID is a symbol of immense power, steeped in mystery and intrigue. With its holographic design and cryptic details, it represents an unparalleled connection to unseen dimensions and hidden networks. This unique artifact carries the name of its sole gatekeeper, ensuring exclusive access to the underworld and its untapped potential.

For businesses navigating the challenges of bureaucracy and corruption, this sticker offers more than symbolic value—it's a declaration of protection. Displayed within a business's premises, it signifies approval by the one individual who holds the rights to its immense power. This protection extends across dimensions, shielding businesses from unlawful inspections and ensuring ethical practices.

Ownership of the Council ID Sticker is subscription-based, starting at -+£2000 per year for small businesses like coffee shops. This annual fee grants businesses the right to display the sticker, symbolizing their compliance with ethical standards and their commitment to worker rights. However, it's important to note that true ownership remains with its creator, who retains ultimate authority over its placement and usage.

Should any business face unjust fines or unlawful interference during their subscription period, the sticker's overseer will personally ensure restitution, and those responsible will face the weight of karmic justice. Conversely, if a fine is deemed legitimate, the sticker will be revoked, and the business forfeits its fee as a reminder of their obligation to uphold their commitments.

Bearing the Council ID Sticker connects businesses not just to a network of protection but also to a mythos rooted in an unseen world. Its design hints at layers of meaning, serving as a reminder that this is no ordinary emblem. By subscribing to its power, businesses align themselves with an interdimensional legacy of justice, integrity, and accountability.
